Title: Rohan's Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Hema - 39 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Aditi - 10 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Hema and Aditi stand near him.]

Hema: "Rohan, what's the plan today?"

[Rohan dances to the music.]

Rohan: "Exactly right."

[Rohan sings a song.]

Hema: "Rohan, are you okay?"

[Rohan shakes his head.]

Aditi (gently): "Oh wow!"

[Rohan scratches his head.]

Rohan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan shouts angrily.]

Hema (gently): "One more time!"

[Rohan takes the bag from Mother.]

Aditi: "What a day to remember!"
